GSEA Pipeline for Bulk RNA-seq

Bio_Bulk_gsea_pipeline.Rd

Run GSEA from differential expression results and save outputs.

Usage

Bio_Bulk_gsea_pipeline(
  deg_results,
  gmt_file = NULL,
  project_name = "Project",
  org_db = "org.Hs.eg.db",
  organism = "hsa",
  pvalue_cutoff = 0.05
)

Arguments

deg_results

Differential expression results with `gene` (gene symbol) and `logFC` (log2 fold-change).

gmt_file

Optional GMT file path (e.g., MSigDB C7). If `NULL`, run KEGG GSEA.

project_name

Project name for output files.

org_db

Organism annotation package name or OrgDb object (default: "org.Hs.eg.db").

organism

KEGG organism code (default: "hsa").

pvalue_cutoff

P-value cutoff for GSEA (used for plotting/filtering).

Value

A `gseaResult` object.
